limits: For red wine, the complementary grapes together: at least 90%
For red wine, Grenache: at least 50%
For red wine, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 20%
For rosé wine, the minor grapes together: at most 10%
The minor grapes together: at most 10%

blurb.text: A southern Rhône cru, one of the 17 crus of Côtes du Rhône, at the foot of the Dentelles de Montmirail. It is mostly red, from Grenache, Mourvèdre, Syrah and Cinsault, with some white and rosé. The wines are similar to nearby Gigondas and Cairanne.
